notes: Each target is optimised independently; no nesting or monotonicity is imposed.
Seed stability (stability_full_grid) and target comparisons share one basis: unweighted full-grid cells.
kept/merged/split/reconfigured are exclusive per low region and sum to low_regions.

floor_bound marks targets where the repair lifted every candidate above the target and the achieved capture still exceeds it by more than one ladder step; the achieved value there is set by the repair, not by the target.
ARI/VI/NMI are on all grid cells (inactive cells follow their host atom).
Cross-table counts use outgoing commute flow per cell as weight; frozen exempt components are excluded from both the cross table and the flow transitions.
Flow transitions classify every OD row by whether it is internal at the low and at the high target.
Region names are the sigungu receiving the most commute destinations inside the region, for reading only.
The published reference is the max-rule policy ladder used as gamma start values.

stability_full_grid.basis: full-grid cells (atoms expanded through host), same as target-to-target comparisons

shape.note: Polsby-Popper 4*pi*cells/perimeter^2 (square = 0.785); thin cells have <= 2 same-region rook neighbours
